articles.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in airstrike, Trump says
articles.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.

articles.title: Warner Bros $111bn sale to Paramount approved by US justice department
articles.description: The approval marks a key development in the merger that will reshape media, allowing the continue of the takeover of the Hollywood studio, which owns CNN and HBO.

articles.title: The college scam that promised students fleeing war a new life in Finland
articles.description: BBC speaks to students from war-torn Myanmar who say they were cheated after paying to study abroad.

articles.title: 'I will come home safely': Indian sailor's last words to wife before a US strike killed him
articles.description: Patnala Suresh and his wife were looking forward to celebrating their 15th wedding anniversary this month.

articles.title: Leader of Venezuelan gang killed in US strike, Trump says
articles.description: President Donald Trump has said a "swift and lethal kinetic" US military strike has killed "the infamous leader" of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua street gang.

articles.title: Ukraine's strikes on Crimea refineries and pipelines spark worst fuel crisis on peninsula since 2014
articles.description: Ukraine's continued strikes on fuel supplies to Crimea have sparked the worst fuel crisis on the Russian-held peninsula since it was illegally annexed by Russia in 2014.

articles.title: Woman seriously injured in latest Australia shark attack
articles.description: A woman has been seriously injured in a shark attack off a Sydney beach in the fourth incident of its kind in recent weeks.

articles.title: Risk of 'very strong' El Nino raising global temperatures, scientists warn
articles.description: Forecasters say there is a risk of a "very strong" El Nino, which typically leads to higher global temperatures and drought in some areas, but heavy rainfall in others.

articles.title: Fuel running dry in Russian-held Crimea as Ukraine steps up attacks
articles.description: Petrol stations in the Russian-held ‌Crimea had run dry on Thursday, witnesses said, after Ukraine stepped up drone strikes on supply lines to the peninsula.
